_about: The registry the release gate (tools/release_gate.py) reads. What gates is what CAN be solved: `open` (reading the vendor's app, another source or PairFree's own code, or building, can settle it) refuses a release that touches the brand, unless the owner waived it in data/release_waivers.json. What cannot be solved by reading is noted and does not gate, but must carry its proof (owner, 2026-11-21): `needs-report` (only a user's report or other outside information settles it: `needs` says what to ask for), `blocked` (a hard rule: `rule`), `not-applicable` (the vendor's app has no such control); each lists `read` (paths read, with what they showed) and `evidence` (searches over the app's files that the gate runs again; a needs-report item needs one with `expect: some` that finds the code in question). `built` is done. Add an item as soon as a post, a report or an audit shows a gap, set it to built in the change that builds it, and never settle an item as impossible without having read the code.

items.what: Issue #58: after a disconnect the earbuds are in the standard connection mode while PairFree shows the last choice. Read: Life sets the mode only from two screens and never on connecting; PairFree opens a new session for every channel and reads the mode (006C) first, and keeps the last state on screen only while the channel is being reopened. So either the earbuds answer 01 while they play in standard mode, or the read did not arrive; the code cannot tell which.

items.what: PersoniFi's hearing test as JBL Headphones 5.37.10 runs it (2026-11-24, docs/jbl/PROTOCOL.md section 4.14): the curve (JblPersonifi, a port of libpersonifiAlgorithm.so checked against the library in an emulator), JblPersonifiRun (nine tones for each ear, the extra 750 Hz, 1.5 kHz and 3 kHz tones, the scale), the A1 and protocol 4 messages around each tone (JblPersonifiMode: setup flow, side and frequency, the earbuds' answer the app waits for, the end), the warble tones PairFree makes (JblWarble, levels and shape measured from the decoded resource files), the hold-to-hear screen (JblPersonifiScreen), the curve written as category 201 with its 24 bands and PersoniFi switched on, and the PersoniFi switch itself as a row. Never tried on JBL earbuds. The Airoha models (Live Buds 3, Tour Pro 3) send it as RACE: status 0062/0063, setup flow 0073 and the curve 0071 (MmiStage_SetPersoniFiStatus, _SetupFlow, _SetPersoniFiEQ); the Club One through the 41 transfer in category 3.

models: Live Free 2, Reflect Aero, Quantum TWS (the models whose folder EarCanalTesting.zip holds)
items.what: The ear canal test of the Airoha models is not a read: AirohaDeviceStatusControl's EAR_CANAL_TESTING flow unzips the asset EarCanalTesting.zip and runs Airoha's ANC user trigger (AncStageStartAncUserTrigger, RACE 0901 with module 5, AirohaAncUserTriggerStateMachine) which measures the ear canal, works out new feedback ANC filter coefficients in Java (AncUserTriggerUtils) from per-model tuning tables, and writes them to both earbuds (AncStageUpdateAncUserTriggerCoef and its relay to the partner). The tables are the zip's folders 2067 (Live Free 2), 207B (Reflect Aero) and 207D (Quantum TWS): about 3 MB each (Pzp.txt, Pzp2.txt, sz_fb.txt of about 970 KB each, with ut_para.txt, wz_*_filter.txt and loss_*.txt). They are the vendor's own tuning data, so including them (or numbers derived from them) in PairFree needs the owner's agreement (CLAUDE.md, Hard rules: derived facts go into data/ only after the owner has agreed), and the test rewrites the earbuds' noise cancelling filters. The Live Buds 3 and Tour Pro 3 have no folder in the zip, so the flow cannot run for them; their fit checks (the seal check and noise check) are built. Owner, 2026-11-24: PairFree does not carry the tables and does not build the test.

read.what: case 38 of execFlow (EAR_CANAL_TESTING): picks the folder by model name, unzips assets/EarCanalTesting/EarCanalTesting.zip and calls startAncUserTrigger with that folder; asks for the partner earbud
the calculation reads ut_para.txt, loss_*.txt, sz_fb.txt, Pzp2.txt and wz_*_filter.txt from the input folder
RACE 0901 with module 5 starts the trigger and feeds every response (and the partner's relay) to AirohaAncUserTriggerStateMachine
folders 2067, 207B and 207D only, each with about 3 MB of tuning tables
